title: Retail Installment Contracts System Reference: Applying a Hardship Extension and Its Fee
content:
**Policy entry.** This rule fixes the fee charged when a hardship extension is applied to an active contract under Retail Installment Contracts, under the borrower's signed extension agreement. The extension moves the next due date and the final installment date (maturity date) later by the installments the agreement defers, on the same due day.

**When the fee is fixed.** The hardship extension fee is fixed only after the contract's records carry an extension agreement the borrower has signed and that has not yet been applied, naming the installments it defers. The hardship extension fee is not fixed until the contract's oldest unpaid installment carries its late charge whenever that installment's late-charge grace period has ended.

## Capability

`grant_hardship_extension_883d335d` applies a borrower's signed hardship extension agreement to the contract. One call records the extension effective today for the installments the signed agreement defers, moves the next due date and final installment date later by that many months on the same due day, books the extension fee passed (added to fees due) or records the fee as waived when the amount passed is zero, and marks the agreement applied. The borrower sees the new due dates and any extension fee owed. The tool takes the fee it is given; it does not work it out.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `grant_hardship_extension_883d335d` and calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_id` | the contract reference number of the retail installment contract being extended, as returned by the contract lookup | text identifier |
| `service_request_id` | the reference number of the borrower's signed extension agreement on that contract, as returned by the servicing-request lookup or by the signing receipt | text identifier |
| `extension_fee_usd` | the extension fee charged for this extension | USD, 2 decimal places, 0.00 or more; stored rounded half-up to the cent exactly as passed; 0.00 records the fee as waived |

## Return

A receipt rendered as text with `servicing_event_id` (the reference of the extension record), `contract_id`, `extension_months` (installments deferred, integer), `new_next_due_date` and `new_maturity_date` (the YYYY-MM-DD dates the extension sets), `fee_treatment` (`fee_assessed` when a fee was booked, `fee_waived` when none), `extension_fee_usd` (the fee booked, 2 decimal places), `fee_txn_id` (ledger reference of the fee entry, empty text when no fee was booked) and `status`, the text applied, meaning the extension is in effect.
